characters.name: Kjærringdatteren
characters.description: Daughter of the wife, known for being lazy and careless. She has a slouchy posture and often appears disheveled. She wears untidy clothing, likely a simple dress patched awkwardly. Her hair is messy and tangled, and she carries an air of dismissiveness in her expressions. Associated objects include a spindle of prickers, and later, a red chest that ends up being a source of misfortune.

characters.name: Manddatteren
characters.description: Daughter of the husband, diligent and gentle, with features that express kindness and modesty. She stands with a graceful, yet humble demeanor, typically dressed in clean and practical clothing, well-suited for work. Her hair is neat and tied back. She's often seen performing tasks efficiently, including spinning, milking, and shearing. She is associated with several objects, including a blue chest marked with three crosses.

characters.name: Troldkjærringen
characters.description: An old and scraggly witch-like figure living in a large farmhouse. She has sharp features and wears tattered, dark clothing, likely adorned with mysterious symbols. Her gaze is piercing, and she exudes an aura of menace and cunning. She employs trickery and challenges people who want to work for her. Associated objects include three chests—red, green, and blue.
